facts.title: broccoli slaw
ingredients: 3 tablespoons finely chopped shallot or red onion
1/2 cup (120 ml or 125 grams) buttermilk, well-shaken
1 teaspoon to 1 tablespoon (5 to 15 grams) granulated sugar
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 heads of broccoli (1.75 to 2 pounds or 800 to 900 grams)
1/2 cup thinly (45 grams) sliced almonds, toasted
1/3 cup (40 grams) dried cranberries, chopped tiny if you wish
facts.author: Deb Perelman
